items.title: Chipotle stock surges after burrito chain beats expectations, says it's 'not involved' in cyclospora outbreak
items.summary: Chipotle posted a strong second quarter as the burrito chain's growth strategy took off, offsetting macro uncertainty.

items.title: Chipotle CEO says the chain is tackling one of its biggest problems
Chipotle Stock Jumped on Improving Traffic. Cyclospora Impact Might Be Overstated.
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill managed to beat earnings and revenue estimates, but margins and labor pose a challenge for the burrito chain.

items.title: Jersey Mike’s Stock Slides Below IPO Price in Market Debut
items.summary: Jersey Mike’s Subs  is a sandwich chain that professes to make “A Sub Above.”  The New Jersey-based company’s stock made its debut Thursday on the New York Stock Exchange with the ticker symbol JMKE.  More than 85% of Jersey Mike’s is owned by asset management giant  Blackstone  which will hold 70% after the IPO.

items.title: Fast-Casual Chain Tops Buy Point, While Lettuce Crisis Fades For Taco Bell. Starbucks Is Turning Around.
items.summary: Better-than-expected earnings sent Chipotle Mexican Grill past a buy point Thursday while Yum Brands seemed to be overcoming a lettuce-linked illness that hurt its Taco Bell chain.  Starbucks showed signs its turnaround was taking effect.  Chipotle shares jumped more than 12% to the highest level since early February.

items.title: Yum! Brands Stock Bounces Back as Taco Bell Shrugs Off Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
items.summary: Yum! Brands says Taco Bell sales are recovering after an initial slump brought on by the cyclosporiasis outbreak.

items.title: Is CMG Stock Worth Buying After Its Second-Quarter Earnings Beat?
items.summary: Chipotle's earnings beat and raised sales outlook signal improving momentum, but premium valuation and margin pressure keep the buy case balanced.

items.title: Chipotle Growth Strategy Gains Ground While Cost Pressures Persist
items.summary: CMG's traffic, Rewards gains, HEEP rollout and restaurant openings strengthen growth, but rising costs pressure margins.
